Sam —

Quick technical notes and an inline snippet to get your infra started. Full examples in the ZIP.

Recommended SDK settings (v1.8.2):
- connection_timeout_ms: 3000
- read_timeout_ms: 12000
- max_retries: 4 (exponential backoff, jitter)
- default_batch_size: 8 (raise to 16 for high-throughput jobs)

Endpoint migration pattern (safe rollback):
1) Create canary route on the Redwood console -> 10% traffic for 2 hours
2) Observe latency + 5xx rate; rollback if 5xx > 0.5% or p95 latency regresses > 40%
3) Progress 10% -> 30% -> 60% -> 100% with 1–2 hour stabilizations

Node snippet (inline):
const Redwood = require('@redwood/inference');
const client = new Redwood.Client({ apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY, timeout: 12000 });
async function classify(text) {
  try {
    const res = await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-base-1', prompt: text });
    return res.output;
  } catch (err) {
    // exponential backoff handled by SDK up to max_retries
    throw err;
  }
}

Notes on keys & rotation:
- Use short-lived tokens for host-level services and rotate every 24h for production callers; we provide a token-issuing endpoint pattern in the checklist.
- Audit logs: /v1/audit/events exports all token use for the last 90 days.

I'll bring a migration checklist to the kickoff and can run through a dry-run with your infra team.

—Vivek
